what: A winding hand-drawn dotted line on the section background is revealed from top to bottom as you scroll — revealed height (% of section height) = (scroll − section head) ÷ length × 100 + 12. It is bound directly to scroll with no curve or easing, and when scrolled well above the section head (value negative) it keeps the last height. The dotted drawing itself stays as is and only the cover height grows, so it looks like the ”length is being drawn”.

options.lead: Share visible from the start (%), default 12
options.end: Element that sets the end of the length (css) — up to that element’s top counts as 100%. If none, section height
options.[data-fx-part=clip]: Growing cover — height changes with --fx-reveal(%). Place a dotted-line SVG inside (sized to the section height)

from.where: index.html .kg-content (first page body — bg_line dotted path, faint .2, length ends = News section header, +12%)
